arguments.message: Hi! It sounds like your integration is only pulling the first page of results. To get all records, make sure your code follows the `next_cursor` field in each response. Keep requesting the next page until the response no longer contains a `next_cursor`. That loop pattern is what every list endpoint expects. Once you implement that, your dashboard should show all recent records again.
